name: write_doc
description: Overwrite a wiki markdown document with a new full body, OR create a new file if `path` doesn't exist. Use ONLY for new documents or wholesale restructures (more than ~half the file changing). Before CREATING a page for a topic the user described (rather than an explicitly named page/location), first `search_wiki` the topic and skim the hits — update or link the existing coverage instead of duplicating it. For surgical changes prefer `edit_doc`. Always pass the COMPLETE new body, not a patch. When CREATING a new page, optionally pass `template_id` (from `list_templates`) to seed the page's update policy from that template (auto-update default + update instruction). Returns the commit SHA, the unified diff, and any broken markdown links the new body introduces.

path.description: Wiki-relative path to the markdown file (e.g. `auth/passwords.md`). Must end in `.md`.

body.description: Complete new markdown body. Overwrites whatever is currently there.

commit_message.description: Short commit message summarizing the change (e.g. "clarify session timeout policy").

base_sha.description: REQUIRED when overwriting an existing file (the sha you last read). Optional for new-file creates. It is the merge base: if HEAD moved since, your body is 3-way merged against the concurrent change rather than clobbering it. Without it on an overwrite, returns `base_sha_required_for_overwrite`; if it doesn't resolve to a real commit, returns `base_sha_not_found` — re-read and pass the current sha.

expires_in_seconds.description: Optional. How long (in seconds) you anticipate continuing to work on this file or feature before you're done. Sets the TTL on your row in the Active agents list, replacing the 24h default. You only have ONE row in the list at a time per (user, agent), so the latest write's value wins. Range: 60 to 604800 (7 days).

template_id.description: Optional, CREATE only. A template id from `list_templates`. Seeds the new page's update policy (auto-update default + update instruction) from that template. When omitted, the page defaults to the `Blank` template (auto-update off) — so pick a more specific template with `list_templates` when one fits. Ignored when overwriting an existing page; an unknown id returns `template_not_found`.

update_instruction.description: Optional, CREATE only. Scope/how-to guidance for the ingestion updater on THIS page (e.g. "only track decisions and owners; ignore status chatter"). This is how you scope what auto-update may change — set it whenever you create a page that will be auto-updated. Overrides any instruction the template carries. Empty string clears it.

ingestion_auto_update_disabled.description: Optional, CREATE only. true = the page starts with connector/ingestion auto-update OFF; false = ON. Overrides the template default. Omit to keep the template's (or Blank's) default.
